name: @mieweb/pulse-embed
description: Host contract and JS client for embedding Pulse (PulseKit) in a Capacitor or Cordova app.

scripts.build: npm run build:clean && npm run build:js && npm run build:types && npm run build:check
scripts.build:check: node --input-type=module -e "import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; const { exports } = JSON.parse(readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')); const entries = Object.entries(exports).filter(([k, v]) => v.default && existsSync('./src/' + k.slice(2) + '/index.ts')).map(([, v]) => v.default); for (const e of entries) await import(e); console.log('dist loads in Node:', entries.join(', '));"
